name: KIDA-Robot-v01
description: KIDA-01 (Kinetic Interactive Drive Automaton): a Raspberry Pi 5 tank robot with a Hailo-8L AI accelerator (13 TOPS), night-vision and IMX500 AI cameras, and a local LLM. Voice chat, face recognition, routes, go-home, autonomous navigation and an inner life of mood and memory, all on-device.

paragraphs: KIDA represents the pinnacle of the RIFT fleet. Built on the Raspberry Pi 5, it leverages the Hailo-8L AI accelerator to perform high-speed neural processing at the edge. With a dual-camera setup for multi-spectrum vision and local LLM integration, KIDA is designed for sophisticated human-robot interaction and autonomous decision-making without relying on the cloud.
features: [x] Neural Edge Processing: 13 TOPS of AI compute via Hailo-8L for real-time object detection and tracking.
[x] Hybrid Dual-Vision: Simultaneous processing of Night Vision and 4K AI camera feeds for 24/7 situational awareness.
[x] Local LLM Integration: Privacy-focused voice interaction and logic processing running entirely on-device.
[x] Autonomous Navigation: Advanced SLAM and obstacle avoidance powered by high-speed Raspberry Pi 5 architecture.
